routing.question_instructions: Which route fits the work this Kanban card asks for?

routes.name: easy
routes.criterion: Very easy to easy work: a small, well-specified change in one or two files, a documentation or wording edit, or a mechanical change with an exact test.

routes.name: medium
routes.criterion: A well-specified change across several files, or a change that needs reading surrounding code but no design decision.

routes.name: hard
routes.criterion: Everything else, including design decisions, debugging without a known cause, security, payment, migration or deployment work.
